target_scope: Publication-time knowledge-base and knowledge-structure evidence plus separately calibrated D3/D5/D8 future-influence forecasts; never total innovation, scientific quality, or acceptance probability.

dimension_inclusion_rules.D1: At least one verifiable foundational theoretical or methodological source.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D2: At least one paper-level scientometric operationalization.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D3: At least two mathematically distinct publication-time signal families.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D4: Role is distinct from controls, rigor, visibility, and future outcomes.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D5: Implementable from the frozen ASPR corpus or explicitly conditional local-snapshot view.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D6: At least one independent validity study, known-group study, or preregistered validity test.
dimension_inclusion_rules.D7: Represents a scientific construct rather than a modality or preprocessing method.

indicator_inclusion_rules.I1: Maps to exactly one retained dimension unless it is a declared control or outcome.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I2: Has a verifiable original or established mathematical source.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I3: Formula, direction, parameters, graph layer, and window are frozen.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I4: Maximum feature information time is strictly before publication year.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I5: Graph direction, weights, community method, and null model are registered where applicable.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I6: Missing and structural-undefined values have explicit non-imputation semantics.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I7: Can be derived from frozen local raw assets without network access.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I8: Passes a hand-calculated toy-data unit test.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I9: Approximation agrees with exact implementation at Spearman >=0.95 and median relative error <=0.05, when approximation is used.
indicator_inclusion_rules.I10: Registered before future outcomes or sealed holdout results are inspected.

runtime_promotion_rules.P1: Every model-active implementation resolves and every registered hand-calculated unit test passes.
runtime_promotion_rules.P2: Every feature row passes source_max_year < publication_year with zero temporal leakage violations.
runtime_promotion_rules.P3: Registered source, reference, taxonomy, and graph-layer coverage thresholds pass without outcome-dependent exclusions.
runtime_promotion_rules.P4: Outcome-blind subsampling, graph-pruning, parameter, and taxonomy stability thresholds pass where applicable.
runtime_promotion_rules.P5: Every adapted or approximate implementation passes its registered exact/reference equivalence threshold.
runtime_promotion_rules.P6: The dimension passes its preregistered convergent, discriminant, or known-group construct-validity tests.
runtime_promotion_rules.P7: Direction and measurement behavior are stable across publication eras and all reportable Nature domains.
runtime_promotion_rules.P8: Registry hash predates outcome inspection, sealed holdout remains locked, and no OOF-dependent metric or sample selection occurred.

dimension_exclusion_rules: A data modality is not a construct dimension.
A block mixing innovation, exposure, and outcome variables is reassigned or excluded.
A construct fully contained in another retained dimension is not duplicated.
A dimension without paper-level operationalization or current-data feasibility is exploratory only.
A dimension without independent validity evidence and without a frozen validity plan is excluded.
indicator_exclusion_rules: Any feature using future citations, future citers, future communities, or future reuse is excluded from publication-time evidence.
Unverifiable sources, incomplete formulas, and renamed project heuristics are excluded.
Visibility, venue, field size, author, and institution variables are controls, not innovation evidence.
Exact algebraic duplicates and parameter variants cannot enter as independent primary variables.
Unavailable text or unresolved graph semantics make a signal exploratory or excluded.
No signal may be added, removed, or reparameterized because it improves OOF or sealed-holdout performance.

N1_RECOMBINATION.label: Recombinational novelty
N1_RECOMBINATION.construct: Historically unusual or first-time combinations among the focal paper's cited knowledge sources.
N1_RECOMBINATION.validity_plan: Treat the independently supported U family as primary; compare first-time-pair and Uzzi families without assuming equivalence; require discriminant separation from field diversity and reference count in response to published overlap critiques; run landmark and review negative-control analyses.
N1_RECOMBINATION.admission_decision: Retained conditionally because the strict T0 source-pair implementation is an adaptation until source-type filtering and exact/approximation equivalence pass.

C1_KNOWLEDGE_DIVERSITY.label: Knowledge-base diversity and integration
C1_KNOWLEDGE_DIVERSITY.construct: The variety, balance, and cognitive disparity of scientific fields represented in the focal paper's strictly prior reference list, plus their share-weighted integration; contextual evidence about breadth and integration, not direct proof of novelty.
C1_KNOWLEDGE_DIVERSITY.validity_plan: Test reference-subsampling, field-profile, and taxonomy stability; report variety, balance, and disparity as non-interchangeable components and Rao-Stirling as the integrated index; quantify their redundancy and require discriminant separation from reference count and recombinational novelty.
C1_KNOWLEDGE_DIVERSITY.admission_decision: Definition-stage confirmatory candidate only. Runtime promotion requires P1-P8; the label explicitly avoids equating interdisciplinarity with innovation. A preregistered discriminant audit merged the former cognitive-integration subdimension into this source-defined multidimensional construct without removing any metric.

S1_STRUCTURAL_VARIATION.label: Prospective structural variation
S1_STRUCTURAL_VARIATION.construct: Publication-time perturbation induced when the focal reference list adds co-citation links to a strictly historical document co-citation network.
S1_STRUCTURAL_VARIATION.validity_plan: Match CiteSpace on fixed toy and sampled real subnetworks, run resolution/pruning sensitivity, and reproduce landmark known-group direction before confirmatory promotion.
S1_STRUCTURAL_VARIATION.admission_decision: Retained conditionally; published formulas are implemented, but CiteSpace equivalence and graph-scaling sensitivity remain mandatory promotion gates.

N2_SEMANTIC_NOVELTY.label: Semantic prior-art distance
N2_SEMANTIC_NOVELTY.construct: Distance or surprise of a paper's textual knowledge contribution relative to strictly prior literature.
N2_SEMANTIC_NOVELTY.validity_plan: Require audited abstract coverage, a frozen local model with pre-target training cutoff, human-coded validation, and cross-domain invariance before promotion.
N2_SEMANTIC_NOVELTY.admission_decision: Exploratory only because the current canonical target table lacks audited abstract coverage and no frozen human validation exists.

N1.U.cutoff_rule: All historical papers contributing N, N_i, N_j, and O_ij have publication_year < focal publication_year.

parameters.pair_unit: OpenAlex source after journal-like source audit

N1.U.missingness_rule: Null when fewer than two mapped reference sources or no historical denominator exists; add fold-local missing flag.
N1.U.structural_undefined_rule: Never coerce an undefined pair distribution to zero.

quality_rules.provenance: Project preregistration: Spearman >=0.90 and median relative error <=0.10 without outcomes.

N1.U.disposition_reason: Conditional: source-pair and historical-only adaptation must match the preregistered exact/reference implementation before confirmatory use.

N1.FIRST_SHARE.cutoff_rule: Pair history contains only citing papers with publication_year < focal publication_year.

parameters.pair_unit: OpenAlex source after journal-like source audit

N1.FIRST_SHARE.missingness_rule: Null when fewer than two mapped reference sources.
N1.FIRST_SHARE.structural_undefined_rule: No valid pair is undefined, not zero novelty.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind project threshold; sensitivity at 0.6 and 0.9.

N1.FIRST_SHARE.disposition_reason: Conditional profile evidence only: OpenAlex source types require audit and independent validity studies report weaker or overlapping construct validity for first-time combinations.

N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.formula: mean(d_ij | O_ij,<T0=0) over novel mapped source pairs
N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.graph_layer: strictly-prior source co-occurrence plus frozen source citation-profile cosine distance
N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.cutoff_rule: Pair occurrence and source profiles use only years strictly before focal publication.
N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.missingness_rule: Null when no novel pair has a defined frozen distance.
N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.structural_undefined_rule: A paper with no first-time pair is tagged no_novel_pair and left null, not assigned zero distance.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind project threshold; sensitivity at 0.6 and 0.9.

N1.FIRST_DISTANCE.disposition_reason: Profile-only member of the first-time-pair family; it cannot add an independent primary degree of freedom.

N1.UZZI_P10.formula: -Q0.10((O_ij-E_ij)/sigma_ij); E and variance use a fixed-marginal hypergeometric null, validated against degree-preserving bipartite swaps
N1.UZZI_P10.cutoff_rule: Observed and null pair distributions contain no same-year or future papers.
N1.UZZI_P10.missingness_rule: Null when fewer than 20 valid source pairs or null variance is zero.
N1.UZZI_P10.structural_undefined_rule: Zero null variance is flagged and remains null.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind convergence across repeated null draws.

N1.UZZI_P10.disposition_reason: Conditional until the upstream marginal-preserving null engine and approximation convergence are validated.

N1.UZZI_MEDIAN.formula: Q0.50((O_ij-E_ij)/sigma_ij) under the same fixed-marginal hypergeometric approximation as N1.UZZI_P10
N1.UZZI_MEDIAN.cutoff_rule: Observed and null pair distributions contain no same-year or future papers.
N1.UZZI_MEDIAN.missingness_rule: Null when fewer than 20 valid source pairs or null variance is zero.
N1.UZZI_MEDIAN.structural_undefined_rule: Zero null variance is flagged and remains null.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind convergence across repeated null draws.

N1.UZZI_MEDIAN.disposition_reason: Reported jointly with atypicality but not counted as a separate primary model family.

C1.VARIETY.graph_layer: focal reference list with frozen OpenAlex field taxonomy
C1.VARIETY.cutoff_rule: Only references with publication_year < focal publication_year enter.
C1.VARIETY.missingness_rule: Null when no valid reference field exists; never infer field from outcome data.
C1.VARIETY.structural_undefined_rule: One represented field has variety one.

quality_rules.provenance: Spearman >=0.90 and median relative error <=0.10 under reference subsampling.

C1.VARIETY.disposition_reason: Definition-stage confirmatory candidate supporting context; runtime P1-P8 promotion is required and it is never labeled direct novelty.

C1.PIELOU.cutoff_rule: Only references with publication_year < focal publication_year enter.
C1.PIELOU.missingness_rule: Null with a structural_undefined flag when V<=1; fold-local imputation plus missing flag is allowed only in prediction.
C1.PIELOU.structural_undefined_rule: Do not coerce V<=1 to perfect balance or zero balance in the public profile.

quality_rules.provenance: Spearman >=0.90 and median relative error <=0.10 under reference subsampling.

C1.PIELOU.disposition_reason: Definition-stage confirmatory candidate for balance; Shannon entropy is not admitted separately because it is the numerator of Pielou evenness.

C1.DISPARITY.formula: mean(1-cosine(profile_k,profile_l)) over occupied distinct field pairs
C1.DISPARITY.cutoff_rule: Every citation contributing a field profile has source publication_year < focal publication_year.
C1.DISPARITY.missingness_rule: Null when fewer than two occupied fields or a required profile is unavailable.
C1.DISPARITY.structural_undefined_rule: Single-field reference lists are flagged structurally undefined, not assigned maximum or minimum disparity.
C1.DISPARITY.disposition_reason: Definition-stage confirmatory candidate for the disparity component; it is reported separately from variety and balance and requires strictly prior profile coverage and stability.

C1.RAO.formula: sum_k sum_l p_k*p_l*d_kl using frozen strictly-prior cosine distances
C1.RAO.graph_layer: focal reference fields plus strictly-prior field citation profiles
C1.RAO.cutoff_rule: Reference fields and distance profiles use no same-year or future information.
C1.RAO.missingness_rule: Null when there is no valid field; missing pair distance yields null plus coverage flag.
C1.RAO.structural_undefined_rule: A one-field distribution has a mathematically defined Rao value of zero.

quality_rules.provenance: Spearman >=0.90 and median relative error <=0.10 under reference subsampling.

C1.RAO.disposition_reason: Definition-stage confirmatory candidate for the integrated variety-balance-disparity index; redundancy with its reported components is mandatory to disclose.

S1.MCR.formula: (Q(G_s,C)-Q(G_a,C))/Q(G_s,C) with the baseline partition C fixed
S1.MCR.graph_layer: strictly-prior document co-citation graph augmented only by focal reference co-citations
S1.MCR.cutoff_rule: G_s includes only co-citing papers with publication_year < focal publication_year; focal links form G_a.
S1.MCR.missingness_rule: Null when baseline modularity is zero or required references are absent from the graph.
S1.MCR.structural_undefined_rule: Zero baseline modularity remains null and flagged.

quality_rules.provenance: Promotion gate: sampled exact/reference Spearman >=0.95 and median relative error <=0.05.

S1.MCR.disposition_reason: Conditional until CiteSpace equivalence and graph-pruning sensitivity pass.

S1.CL.graph_layer: strictly-prior document co-citation graph and focal novel between-cluster links
S1.CL.cutoff_rule: Baseline linkage contains only pre-publication-year co-citations.
S1.CL.missingness_rule: Null when baseline linkage is zero, total references is zero, or CR cannot be determined.
S1.CL.structural_undefined_rule: No baseline between-cluster linkage remains undefined rather than infinite.

quality_rules.provenance: Promotion gate: sampled exact/reference Spearman >=0.95 and median relative error <=0.05.

S1.CL.disposition_reason: Conditional until the scaling/weight convention is matched against the reference software.

S1.CKL.formula: sum_i p_i*ln(p_i/q_i), p and q are normalized baseline and augmented betweenness distributions with registered epsilon smoothing
S1.CKL.graph_layer: strictly-prior and focal-augmented document co-citation graphs on an identical node set
S1.CKL.cutoff_rule: Baseline graph contains only pre-publication-year co-citations.
S1.CKL.missingness_rule: Null when node sets differ or centrality distributions cannot be normalized.
S1.CKL.structural_undefined_rule: All-zero betweenness distributions are flagged and excluded from profile estimation.

quality_rules.provenance: Promotion gate: sampled exact/reference Spearman >=0.95 and median relative error <=0.05.

S1.CKL.disposition_reason: Conditional because probability normalization and epsilon smoothing must match the reference implementation.

N2.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.formula: Project placeholder: distance to nearest strictly-prior text neighbor; exact model and aggregation are not yet frozen.
N2.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.cutoff_rule: Candidate neighbors and model training corpus must predate the focal publication year.
N2.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.missingness_rule: Null whenever an audited abstract, frozen model, or prior comparison set is unavailable.
N2.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.structural_undefined_rule: Title-only values cannot be silently substituted for abstract-based values.
N2.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.disposition_reason: Exploratory placeholder only; it cannot enter the primary model or public confirmatory profile until text entry requirements pass.

X.DELTA_Q0.formula: Legacy project heuristic formerly named delta_q0_shock.
X.DELTA_Q0.cutoff_rule: Legacy code attempted a prior cutoff but graph semantics differ from SVA.
X.DELTA_Q0.disposition_reason: Excluded from v6 because a generic modularity drop on the wrong graph layer is not SVA Modularity Change Rate.
